videos.script: Two more tools, built on two different ideas. {{two}} Helicone is a gateway. The application sends its requests to Helicone, and Helicone passes them on, recording each one. It sees every model call, and nothing in between. {{gateway}} In the lab it runs, and refuses to forward to the lab's provider, because a gateway that forwards anywhere is an open door. {{refused}} Phoenix is Arize's open-source tracer. It reads the assistant's spans as they are, and turns the model calls into its own kinds. {{phoenix}} It makes the same mistake about the root span that Langfuse made. Two tools, one reading. The attribute is in the wrong place. {{root}} Thumbs go on as annotations, from a human, beside the ones a model and the code will add later. {{annotations}} A gateway answers what was called. Tracing answers why. A large system has both. {{choose}}
